import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Convert text-as-number columns to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (take absolute value)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix body_mass_g out of range: 5050000 is 1000x too large (likely kg instead of g)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Fix sex extra spaces
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return result.to_dict()
